DeepSeek Harness. Install the
bundle, "},{"id":"p7s2","text":"restart DSH, and pick **内阁模式** when starting a new session. The mode is
a research-team preset model"},{"id":"p7s3","text":"ed on the Great Ming Research Bureau cabinet
(大明科研司·内阁): a Lead (内阁首辅) directs members (阁臣) of four "},{"id":"p7s4","text":"bureaus, defaults
to research before touching code, and must never fabricate sources."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"The package ships a host half (`index.js`, the member schema and Cabinet-only prompt provider) and a"},{"id":"p8s2","text":" browser half

- Removed repeated instructions and examples.
- Prompt-leve"},{"id":"p13s3","text":"l task budgets (not runtime-enforced counters): up to 30 tool calls for a single-file task.

| Default posture | Research first, change code only when "},{"id":"p21s5","text":"explicitly authorized; every conclusion must cite a path, line, command output or source; unverified"},{"id":"p21s6","text":" items must be marked as such. |

| Platform | Cross-platform: `tool-bash` is enabled on Linux/macOS, `tool-pws"},{"id":"p21s9","text":"h` on Windows, exactly like Standard Mode. No absolute paths, no shell-specific install step, no bui"},{"id":"p21s10","text":"ld step. |

and non-Windows hosts.
